provenance.pointwise_contract: Recompute acceleration and force at a fixed source state.
provenance.killswitch_contract: Integrate commanded and zero-torque futures from one matched state.
provenance.wscg_convention: DELTA = BASE - counterfactual after time alignment.
provenance.state_interpolation: componentwise linear interpolation of the smooth registered source trace
provenance.terminal_control_sampling: commands sampled at all state times including the terminal endpoint

claim_boundaries.legacy_matlab_sampler: re-simulates to each cut and records the first torque-off sample; not a forward zero-torque future
claim_boundaries.variant_rows: whole-model scenario variants with different pre-cut source traces; not an additive mechanism partition
